body.v: Mara Keller has shared a file with you: "Invoice 2291".
Open the attachment to view the document.

hotspots.explain: The sender writes from clouddrive-files.example. CloudDrive's domain is clouddrive.example, with nothing around it.
CloudDrive shares by link, not by attachment. A file you weren't expecting is worth stopping for.
A colleague's name in the subject is reassuring. But a name takes two seconds to copy from a stolen address book.
"Invoice 2291", with no amount and no context: just enough to make you open the file to see what it is.

who.prompt: Who is really writing to you? Read the address, not just the name.
who.answer: Someone posing as CloudDrive. The sender is on clouddrive-files.example, not clouddrive.example. Mara's name is the bait.

emotion.prompt: Which feeling is this email pressing on?
emotion.answer: Curiosity, plus not wanting to keep a colleague waiting: you want to see what Mara has sent you.
choices: Fear of a penalty or a fine
None, it is a routine message

ask.prompt: What does it actually want you to do?
ask.answer: Open an attachment you weren't expecting. It could install malware or show a fake sign-in page.
choices: Click a link and sign in

verify.prompt: How can you check through a channel you control?
verify.answer: Don't open anything. Ask Mara by phone or in person, or open CloudDrive yourself and see whether she shared anything with you.
choices: Ask Mara, or open CloudDrive yourself
Open the file, it is probably harmless
Reply to the sender for more details

actions.label: Ask Mara, by phone or in person, whether she shared anything with you
actions.consequence: Mara shared nothing. You stopped the attachment before it could run.

actions.label: Open the attachment to see what it is
actions.consequence: The file runs: it shows a fake sign-in page, or installs malware on your computer.

actions.label: Reply to the sender to ask what the file is
actions.consequence: The scammer serves you a more convincing story. And your reply tells them your address is live.

actions.label: Open CloudDrive yourself and check your shared files
actions.consequence: Nothing has been shared with you. The email was fake.

attacker_reveal: An invoice number, Mara's name in the subject, and I let your curiosity do the rest. One double-click and I'd have moved into your computer.
